text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Without further ado—it begins! Welcome
to the Tracen Academy
Pretty Grand Prix!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looks like our whimsical director has
cooked up another new event.
The
students gathered here in the gym
immediately start chattering
among
themselves.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Explanation! As Umamusume, you must be
strong both on and off the
track!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hence! You will compete in three areas:
performing, public speaking,
and racing!
The top four from the preliminaries will
then vie for
victory in the finals!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Accepting entrants! From tomorrow, you
can enter yourself or
recommend another! I
await your courageous challenges!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What a lov'ly event! City, I'll put your
name down for you!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, Yukino?! Seriously?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Grand Prix are just da bomb, aren't they?
I'm gettin' revved up just
imagining it! ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (Sigh... Director Akikawa is back at it again...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...I would love to see Groove excel in the
Grand Prix.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Pretty Grand Prix, huh? Leave it up to
the director to come up
with something
like this. Either way, it doesn't have much
to do with
Curren Chan—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brooo! Get this, get this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Siiis! Get this, get this! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Just now! I signed myself up for the Grand
Prix!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ Like, it's called the Pretty Grand
Prix, right? It's an event fit
for Curren,
through and through—they might as well
put my name on
it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Bro, make sure you cheer me on
looots, okay? ♪ You do that, and
I'll try
my bestest to win!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, make sure you cheer me on looots,
okay? ♪ You do that, and
I'll try my
bestest to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she's motivated... but I'm also
worried her Grand Prix training
might get
in the way of her normal training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll keep working on my
fundies. But at the same time...
the Grand
Prix is just as important to me!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, y'know! I need more people to
know how much of a cutie-pie I
am! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Is clout really the only thing on her
mind? Once again, I feel lost in
the dark
when it comes to Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, um! Big Bro, I wanna show you my
best.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Um, um! Big Sis, I wanna show you my
best.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Won't you let me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cutesy tone makes it difficult for me to
make a decision. This time
though, sensing
a new air of determination around her, I
reluctantly
agree.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can't keep letting her push me
around like this. Resolved
to figure out
what makes her tick, I pick up my phone
and open her
Umasta.

text_block_list.name: @Curren
text_block_list.text:
"Check out this Miracle Pegasus Parfait I
had today! ♪
#FeelTheRainbow
#CurrenSmile #CuteCurrenChan"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oh, here's a selfie she posted of her eating
a parfait... Wait, 49,906
likes?! Let's take
a peek at the comments section...

text_block_list.name: @Curren_is_MyLife
text_block_list.text:
"Even though Curren posts at least three
times a day on her Umasta,
she never
drops a single clue about her private life."

text_block_list.name: @cuteeeeeCurren
text_block_list.text:
"I know, right? Usually, you can get a
general vibe of where people
live or who
they hang out with from their photos."

text_block_list.name: @Curren_is_MyLife
text_block_list.text:
"She's a real enigma. Every photo is always
in a different place with
different people.
'Course, that air of mystery is one of the
things I
love about her!"

text_block_list.name: @UMA_hunter
text_block_list.text:
"I know the truth. Curren is actually an
alien. I mean, she's way too
perfect to be
human."

text_block_list.name: @UMA_hunter
text_block_list.text:
"Some of my buddies say she's an UMA:
Unidentified Mysterious
Angel. They say
she stays so cute by sucking the blood of
others like
a chupacabra."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...That's enough internet for today. The
more I read about Curren
Chan, the less I
feel I know about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of the Pretty Grand Prix
preliminaries has arrived.
First up is the
performance section...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Send me all your love and
support, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Emitting her usual superstar aura, Curren
Chan captivates the crowd
and passes with
flying colors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following public speaking section
goes about the same way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've brought an item that'll make
everyone even cuter! ♪ My
personal
recommendation is... this golden cream
foundation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The last part of the preliminary involves a
time trial race.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time to show my stuff! ♪ Make
sure you catch me
shining—not just with
your eyes, but your cameras too!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Aieeek! We love you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan has natural talent. As long as
she performs like in
practice, she should
be able to get a respectable time... Before
long,
the race kicks off.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeppity-yep, I'm feeling great! ♪
Everyone! Keep your eyes on me—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hm? That's weird...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Something's off about Curren Chan's
running form. Most of the
spectators are so
absorbed in her cuteness that they haven't
noticed
yet, but I'm sure of it...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Eep!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her form is showing cracks! There's no way
she's beating her old
record like this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...At this rate—nnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan powers past the finish line,
but her time leaves
something to be
desired. Still, thanks to her previous two
scores, she
manages to qualify for the
finals.

text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear? Her cleat fell off her shoe.
It's proof she slacked off on
her race prep.

text_block_list.name: Race-loving Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, looks like she couldn't care less
about racing. If she wanted to
be an idol,
she should've just gone somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Fangirl Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Curren... I didn't want to see you like this...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Did Curren Chan overhear what they
were saying? Either way, she's
curled up
into a ball in front of the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Nope. Failing like this is no good. Getting carried away, embarrassing myself... That's not cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: If this is the best I can do...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I don't deserve... to be with Big Bro.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I don't deserve... to be with Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before I have a chance to say anything,
Curren Chan runs off
somewhere. This loss
hit her way harder than I thought it
would...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem like the type of person
to let the naysayers get to
her. But then,
why was she so upset?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Turning back to the track, I spy Curren
Chan's lone cleat, now only
faintly
reflecting the brilliant light of the sun.
